name: Collateral Parties 9
definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties on the instruction side.

PartyA.name: Party A
PartyA.definition: Instructing party sending the collateral instruction.

ClientPartyA.name: Client Party A
ClientPartyA.definition: Party that instructs party A to send the message.

PartyAPresenceRule.definition: If party A is absent then client of party A or triparty agent must be present.

ClientOfPartAPresenceRule.definition: If client of party A is absent then party A or triparty agent must be present.

TripartyAgentPresenceRule.definition: If triparty agent is absent then party A or client of party A must be present.
